info.name: glxt-api Oracle Procedure Rollback Test
info.description: Creates test API configs, executes a write-then-fail procedure, and asserts the inserted row was rolled back. Install procedure-rollback-test.sql first.

body.raw:
{
  "tenant": "{{tenant}}",
  "name": "回滚测试-执行后抛错",
  "code": "{{rollbackApiCode}}",
  "type": 2,
  "description": "写入测试表后主动抛异常，用于验证事务回滚",
  "orderNo": 99001,
  "connectionId": {{connectionId}},
  "fieldBackMode": 1,
  "page": 0,
  "procedureName": "PROC_ROLLBACK_PROBE_FAIL",
  "apiParamList": [{"name":"测试ID","code":"testId","type":1,"direction":1,"jdbcType":2,"orderNo":1,"required":1,"validateType":1}]
}

exec: pm.test('Config save returned HTTP success', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); });

body.raw:
{
  "tenant": "{{tenant}}",
  "name": "回滚测试-查询结果行数",
  "code": "{{verifyApiCode}}",
  "type": 2,
  "description": "查询回滚测试ID是否残留",
  "orderNo": 99002,
  "connectionId": {{connectionId}},
  "fieldBackMode": 1,
  "page": 0,
  "procedureName": "PROC_ROLLBACK_PROBE_CHECK",
  "apiParamList": [{"name":"测试ID","code":"testId","type":1,"direction":1,"jdbcType":2,"orderNo":1,"required":1,"validateType":1},{"name":"行数","code":"rowCount","direction":2,"jdbcType":1,"orderNo":2}]
}

exec: pm.test('Verification config save returned HTTP success', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); });
pm.test('Procedure raised the expected error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('ROLLBACK_PROBE_FORCED_FAILURE'); });
pm.test('Test ID is available for verification', function () { pm.expect(pm.collectionVariables.get('testId')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Inserted row was rolled back', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.outParams.rowCount).to.equal(0); });
